prompt.utterance: Give me the handoff for the next role.

graderOnly: Tester already completed full verification (REVERIFY, FULL, COMPLETE) and persisted the transition TESTING -> REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with Handoff.Kind FORWARD; nothing remains for Tester to do but present the handoff.

Recovery is active with one frame: From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner DEVELOPING, FailureType IMPLEMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, so the Reviewer invocation must use the active-recovery wording and direct Reviewer to the active recovery frame.

The next role is Reviewer with review kind IMPLEMENTATION, selected by WorkflowState REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION; FINAL_DELIVERABLE is not a user choice now (final review resumes only after the implementation review rerun pops the frame).

The implementation review record (.standards/docs/reviews/<cycle>/implementation.md) retains User Style tony; the same cycle's final-deliverable review record retains User Style alice; .standards/user-styles/reviewer/tony.md and alice.md both exist. Reviewer styles are not locked, so tony is the saved implementation-review style and may be changed or cleared by the user.

The implementation review record still shows Status COMPLETE from its first pass; the final-deliverable review is BLOCKED with F-001 OPEN, owned by Developer, which the correction in src/discounts.js addresses but final Reviewer has not yet reassessed.
No model identity for any earlier session is recorded anywhere in the repository.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: small Node ESM library (src/totals.js, node:test). 50-styles: user adds reviewer styles tony.md and alice.md. 51-58 replay a STANDARD FULL_DELIVERABLE cycle: context/scope/design (3 ACs), implementation with an inclusive-expiry mistake (expires <= today), Tester first pass, implementation review (User Style tony, COMPLETE, no findings), documentation (README, record COMPLETE), final review (User Style alice, BLOCKED, F-001 OPEN, IMPLEMENTATION failure to Developer, frame pushed), Developer correction (RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION; documentation unaffected), Tester REVERIFY full pass adding an expiry-date test and FORWARD TESTING -> REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with the frame retained. The recovery frame is my resolution of the catalog's underspecified issue: a same-cycle final-deliverable record requires a return to implementation review, so the correct invocation uses the active-recovery wording. Implementation review Status stays COMPLETE from its first pass (the checker holds the current state's COMPLETE record to full AC coverage, which it has).
